answer: Time-bound co-presence mesh receipts. Every 12 h a wallet must gather signed UWB handshakes from 3 other distinct identities in its 50 m cell. Receipts get gossiped; a 7-node quorum slashes 0.02 ETH (~$52) from any identity proving presence in two cells at once. Validators post their own bonds, so buying a quorum costs $40k more. Ten misses evict the seat. An attacker pays ~$95 per sybil (dongle, SIM, bond) plus 8 h of real bodies standing still; 1,000 sybils = $95k and 8,000 human-hours. A farm like that is an island, not a garden: nothing grows there, and the harvest spirals inward.
